triage.test_level_policy: Augmented F2P tests live in new CPython regrtest unittest files and drive PEP 701 behavior through Python public/module surfaces: token constants, the tokenize module C-tokenizer bridge, ast.parse, compile/eval of f-string source, and source-distribution validation. Augmented P2P tests exercise unrelated public stdlib APIs in string and calendar to guard backwards-compatible behavior outside the f-string parser/tokenizer changes.
triage.requirement_section_source: All requirement_sections strings are copied exactly from the Section column of requirement_pr_pairs/CPython_PEP-701_Syntactic-formalization-of-f-strings_PR-102855.md.

requirement_sections: Specification > Changes to the tokenize module
test.test_pep701_fstring_aug.FStringForm.public_surface: token module constants and tokenize module C-tokenizer bridge returning TokenInfo values.
test.test_pep701_fstring_aug.FStringForm.rationale: The PEP adds distinct FSTRING_START/MIDDLE/END and EXCLAMATION token constants and requires the tokenize-facing C tokenizer to emit them in f-string order. This rejects swapped, duplicated, or missing token identities through the token and tokenize modules.

requirement_sections: Specification > Changes to the tokenize module
Specification > How to produce these new tokens
test.test_pep701_fstring_aug.FStringForm.public_surface: tokenize module C-tokenizer bridge exposing f-string TokenInfo positions.
test.test_pep701_fstring_aug.FStringForm.rationale: The PEP requires tokenizer mode switching to preserve f-string literal spans. A multiline f-string exposes FSTRING_MIDDLE start/end offsets, rejecting the Python-tokenize position mutant while staying on the tokenize module surface.

test.test_pep701_fstring_aug.FStringForm.public_surface: source-distribution check of the shipped CPython token-name table.
test.test_pep701_fstring_aug.FStringForm.rationale: The new token names are part of the shipped CPython token table. Checking the source distribution rejects the mutant that labels token 61 as FSTRING_BEGIN instead of FSTRING_START.

requirement_sections: Specification > How to produce these new tokens
Specification > Consequences of the new grammar
test.test_pep701_fstring_aug.FStringForm.public_surface: eval of f-string literals through Python expression evaluation, plus a source-distribution check of the shipped AST helper text.
test.test_pep701_fstring_aug.FStringForm.rationale: The tokenizer algorithm collapses doubled braces in FSTRING_MIDDLE literal text. Combining that with quote reuse keeps the test fail-to-pass at base, and the source-distribution check rejects patches that silently remove the collapse branch while generated parser artifacts still build.

requirement_sections: Specification > Handling of f-string debug expressions
Specification > Consequences of the new grammar
test.test_pep701_fstring_aug.FStringForm.public_surface: ast.parse public AST for f-string expressions, plus a source-distribution check of the shipped AST helper text.
test.test_pep701_fstring_aug.FStringForm.rationale: The specification requires AST preservation under the new grammar, including flat JoinedStr nodes and no empty Constant fragments. Same-quote expressions make this a PEP-701 fail-to-pass test at base, and the source-distribution check pins the empty-fragment pruning required by the public AST result.

requirement_sections: Specification > How to produce these new tokens
Specification > Consequences of the new grammar
test.test_pep701_fstring_aug.FStringForm.public_surface: eval of raw f-string literals with public rf/fr/Rf prefixes, plus a source-distribution check of the shipped tokenizer raw-prefix branch.
test.test_pep701_fstring_aug.FStringForm.rationale: Raw f-string prefixes must continue to suppress escape decoding in literal portions after tokenizer mode switching. Quote reuse keeps this on the new PEP-701 surface, and the source-distribution check catches raw-prefix regressions before generated parser coverage can mask them.

requirement_sections: Specification > Consequences of the new grammar
test.test_pep701_fstring_aug.FStringForm.public_surface: compile/eval/tokenize of f-string expressions using quote reuse, backslashes, comments, a broad Lib source corpus, and public test_syntax doctest examples.
test.test_pep701_fstring_aug.FStringForm.rationale: PEP 701 lifts expression restrictions for quote reuse, backslashes, and multi-line expression parsing while preserving the syntax error for a same-line comment that consumes the closing brace. The test drives those grammar consequences through eval/compile/tokenize and broad public syntax corpora so generated parser behavior remains covered without counting parser.c in the denominator.

requirement_sections: Specification > How to produce these new tokens
test.test_pep701_fstring_aug.FStringForm.public_surface: eval of same-quote f-strings and nested f-string format-spec replacement fields.
test.test_pep701_fstring_aug.FStringForm.rationale: Nested replacement fields inside format specs are explicitly accepted by the formal grammar. The same-quote guard makes the selector fail in the pre-state, while nested format-spec evals reject tokenizer mode mutants around braces.

requirement_sections: Specification > Handling of f-string debug expressions
test.test_pep701_fstring_aug.FStringForm.public_surface: ast.parse of an f-string debug expression and the col_offset of the implicit debug-text Constant node (public ast module only).
test.test_pep701_fstring_aug.FStringForm.rationale: PEP-701 gives f-string debug expressions accurate AST positions: the implicit debug-text Constant must start at the expression, not the opening brace. mutant_014 shifts its col_offset from the expression (3) to the brace (2); pre-PEP-701 the node carries the f-string's col_offset (0). Runtime debug-text output is unchanged, so this position assertion is the discriminating signal.

test.test_pep701_p2p_aug.Pep701Unchanged.rationale: Backwards compatibility says existing non-f-string semantics are preserved; string.Formatter nested lookups and conversions are adjacent string-formatting behavior outside the modified f-string implementation.
Backwards compatibility says unrelated string APIs remain unchanged; Template substitution and escaping do not use the new f-string tokenizer or parser surface.

test.test_pep701_p2p_aug.Pep701Unchanged.public_surface: calendar.TextCalendar, calendar.isleap, and calendar.setfirstweekday public APIs.
test.test_pep701_p2p_aug.Pep701Unchanged.rationale: Backwards compatibility covers unrelated standard-library behavior. Calendar formatting and weekday validation exercise an existing public API independent of f-string parsing.
